title: Controller Offline
shortDescription: Rachio unit cannot reach the cloud.
fullDescription: Solid blue or breathing blue LED on Rachio Gen 2/3 indicates the controller lost Wi-Fi or cloud connection. Manual zones still run via the button.

fixSteps.title: Re-add device
fixSteps.instruction: Delete and re-add Rachio in the app.

faq.a: Gen 2 is 2.4 only; Gen 3 supports both.

title: No Power / Dark LED
shortDescription: Controller has no light and no response.
fullDescription: When no LED illuminates on Rachio, the unit is receiving no 24VAC input.

title: Zone Short Detected
shortDescription: A zone draws too much current.
fullDescription: App shows 'Short detected on Zone X' when solenoid or wire draws excessive current; the zone is disabled.

fixSteps.title: Disconnect zone
fixSteps.instruction: Remove zone wire; retest to isolate.

fixSteps.title: Replace solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Swap failed solenoid at valve box.

title: Open Circuit on Zone
fullDescription: Open circuit notification means the controller sees no load when running a zone — cut wire, failed coil, or disconnected common.

fixSteps.title: Measure solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Ohm coil at controller; should read ~30Ω.

fixSteps.title: Locate break
fixSteps.instruction: Use wire tracer to find the break.

title: Weather Intelligence Skip
fullDescription: Rachio's Weather Intelligence skips watering when rain, freeze, or high wind thresholds are met. Informational.

fixSteps.title: Adjust thresholds
fixSteps.instruction: Tune Weather Intelligence values in app.

title: Master Valve Not Opening
fullDescription: Reported when the M terminal cannot energize the master valve solenoid; all zones fail with no flow.

fixSteps.title: Enable MV in app
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm Master Valve toggle is on.

title: Pending Firmware Update
fullDescription: App prompts when a firmware update is pending; schedules may be paused during the update window.

fixSteps.title: Accept update
fixSteps.instruction: Tap update in app; controller reboots.

title: Provisioning Mode
fullDescription: Pulsing yellow LED means Rachio is waiting to be provisioned by the phone app.

fixSteps.title: Run app setup
fixSteps.instruction: Follow Add Controller flow in Rachio app.
